ace fenton.name: Ace Fenton
ace fenton.origin: Ace Fenton went on a crime spree in Tombstone, Arizona, wearing a bearskin over a bulletproof suit of steel armor, while wielding a shotgun. Ace led the authorities to believe that a master animal trainer must have been involved, planting a false trail to draw them away from the true culprit. While robbing a Pony Express, Ace had to fight off both the Rawhide Kid and the Two Gun Kid, succeeding in escaping after they ran out of ammunition thanks to his bulletproof steel hide. The Rawhide Kid was believed by many to have been the culprit behind the Pony Express robbery but was convinced by Two Gun Kid to turn himself in for a trial. the rawhide kid was to be defended by Two Gun kid's alter ego, lawyer Matt Hawk. Ace used this opportunity to turn the Rawhide Kid into his scapegoat, trying several times to stir up the locals against the Rawhide kid, claiming that he was obviously the Grizzly's trainer. To further implicate rawhide kid, and prove his claims, ace broke the Two Gun Kid out of the courtroom during his trial, but Rawhide outfought the Grizzly and forced him to flee. Again joined by the Two Gun Kid, Rawhide kid tracked down ace and tricked him into confessing that he was indeed the Grizzly. The pair captured ace after a gunfight and turned him over to local sheriff Brett Barton.

ace peterson.name: Ace Peterson
ace peterson.origin: Ace Peterson is Mike Peterson's son. Ace was with his father when an explosion occurred at a nearby building. Mike promptly tells him to stay with a hotdog vender and goes into the building. After saving a doctor from inside Mike reaches Ace and leaves the area with him. Centipede abducted Ace after they learned Mike had become an agent of S.H.I.E.L.D., and held him hostage in exchange for Agent Phil Coulson. Mike betrayed his fellow agents by telling them Centipede wanted him in exchange for Ace, and handed Coulson over to Centipede. At the last moment, Mike left Ace with the rest of his team and turned around to save Coulson, but was apparently killed in a fiery explosion. Ace was later returned to his aunt under the protection of a S.H.I.E.L.D. team. However, Ace was kidnapped again, this time by Hydra, who held him at a Cybertek facility in New Mexico, under the Incentives Program, where other people were kidnapped to force their loved ones to do Hydra's bidding. Ace was then rescued by Skye, who then informed Mike father that he's safe, enabling Mike to rebel against Hydra. Ace was later reunited with his family, though Mike abstains from seeing him, wanting to redeem himself for the crimes Hydra forced him to commit.

ace turmbull.name: Ace Turmbull
ace turmbull.origin: thumb|left|148px|Ace Turmbull Ace Turmbull was a gambler and thief who was active during the days of the American Frontier. Ace operated out of Buckhorn, Wyoming, and came up with an idea to rob stage coaches while disguised as the Two Gun Kid, fooling the local authorities. Ace was able to avoid arrest, making the sheriff look bad and his son Burt determined to capture the Two Gun Kid so his father would have his reputation restored. When the real Two Gun Kid rode into town, he was determined to clear his name. When the two gun kid was about to confront the sheriff, Ace got to him first and warned the Two Gun kid to flee town as a posse was out looking for him for the theft of a stage coach and the murder of it's driver. Two Gun kid was soon chased out of town by the posse. Ace then disguised himself as Two Gun kid and held up another coach. When Ace fled the scene the real Two Gun kid was attacked by the posse out looking for him and was captured, blinded in the process by a bullet that creased his brow. With a lynch mob forming outside the sheriff's office, Ace once more pretended to aid Two Gun kid by giving him a gun through the bars of the windows to escape from his cell. Two Gun kid managed to escape custody, a blow to the head from Burt restoring his vision and tracked down his impostors hideout a cave which contained a horse and outfit that matched his own. Two Gun kid followed the real thief's backtrail to the local saloon where Two Gun kid outted Ace Turmbull as the impostor, pointing out that the thief always wore shoes and not cowboy boots. When Ace attempted to get the draw on Two Gun kid and the sheriffs, the sheriff's son Burt gunned him down, killing him. Two Gun kid was later cleared of all charges.

Two Gun kid was soon chased out of town by the posse. Ace then disguised himself as Two Gun kid and held up another coach. When Ace fled the scene the real Two Gun kid was attacked by the posse out looking for him and was captured, blinded in the process by a bullet that creased his brow. With a lynch mob forming outside the sheriff's office, Ace once more pretended to aid Two Gun kid by giving him a gun through the bars of the windows to escape from his cell. Two Gun kid managed to escape custody, a blow to the head from Burt restoring his vision and tracked down his impostors hideout a cave which contained a horse and outfit that matched his own. Two Gun kid followed the real thief's backtrail to the local saloon where Two Gun kid outted Ace Turmbull as the impostor, pointing out that the thief always wore shoes and not cowboy boots. When Ace attempted to get the draw on Two Gun kid and the sheriffs, the sheriff's son Burt gunned him down, killing him. Two Gun kid was later cleared of all charges.

achelous.name: Achelous
achelous.origin: ===Ancient History=== Achelous was an Olympian river god living in ancient Greece, born in Acheloos River (within modern-day Trikala Prefecture) the son of the Titans Oceanus and Tethys. Achelous' chosen form was of a giant bull. Achelous fell in love with a mortal named Deianira. Deianira was also an interest of Hercules and so, Achelous challenged him for Deianira's hand in marriage. As the battle raged on, Achelous transformed into a bull and charged at Hercules. Hercules avoided the attack and shattered Achelous' right horn. ===Modern Era=== With a hatred towards Hercules, Achelous agreed to help Eurystheus, Hercules' cousin and bitter rival. They returned from Hades to challenge Hercules again, but once more failed against their bitter foe.

achille dibacco.name: Achille DiBacco
achille dibacco.origin: The original Ani-Men had died fighting Iron Man under orders from Count Nefaria. Achille DiBacco was recruited by the Death Stalker to become a member of the new Ani-Men, alongside with Roy McVey (the new Ape-Man) and Sebastian Patane (Cat-Man). Lacking any superpowers, they were provided with super-powered suits. The Death Stalker intended to use the Ani-Men to fight Daredevil and his lover Black Widow. The Bird Man was defeated by the Black Widow and sent to jail. This saved DiBacco's life because the Death Stalker killed Roy and Sebastian for their failure. Achille retained his Bird Man identity and might have used it to commit additional crimes. Achille was contacted by Gary Gilbert, a former costumed criminal turned business agent for criminals. Gary was worried about the Scourge of the Underworld, a masked figure who was killing costumed criminals such as Gary and Achille. Gary organized a meeting in the Bar with No Name, Medina County, Ohio, to discuss potential counter attacks. As the Scourge was known to use weapons instead of powers, weapons were to be left at the door. However, the Scourge infiltrated in the meeting disguised as the bartender and shot down all the seventeen criminals including Bird Man, wielding a cut down 50 submachine gun in each hand. Bird Man and the other criminals killed by Scourge were later resurrected by The Hood in order to kill the Punisher.
weapons: The Bird-Man had a powerful blaster

achilles helmut.name: Achilles (Helmut)
achilles helmut.species: Human with Frost Giant lineageCategory:Human/Frost Giant Hybrids
achilles helmut.origin: ===Origin=== Helmut was a descendant of Agamemnon, born in Germany in 1909. Helmut married and had a son and two daughters with his wife. ===WWII & Dachau=== Jews, Helmut and his family were captured by the Nazis, and sent to the camp of Dachau during the Holocaust. When they tried to tattoo Helmut, the needle broke. Helmut's wife and three children were gassed. Achilles, himself gassed, realized he was immortal and was thrown into a mass grave containing the corpses of the other victims of the camp. ===Pantheon=== Agamemnon recruited Helmut to serve as an operative for the Pantheon near the end of World War II while Agamemnon was on one of his hiatuses from the Pantheon, which he usually took every 50 years or so. Helmut took the name Achilles due to his powers, and became a member of the Pantheon's elite fighting team, often participating in field missions. Achilles recruited Walter Charles into the Pantheon, becoming his mentor. Agamemnon had ordered Jason to murder the original Ulysses. Achilles took the job instead and arranged for Ulysses and Walter Charles to find Paris during the Watts Riots in 1959. Achilles used a Pantheon weapon to kill Ulysses. Achilles then ensured that Walter would take Ulysses' codename and place within the Pantheon. Achilles resented Agamemnon inviting the Hulk to join the Pantheon. Achilles' weakness turned out to be low level gamma rays. Achilles began a romance with fellow Pantheon member Atalanta. Paris ensured that Achilles and Atalanta would be caught by the mentally disabled Ajax who had feelings for Atalanta. ===Death=== When it was discovered that Agamemnon had betrayed the Pantheon, only Achilles stayed loyal to Agamemnon. Achilles died during a duel with Ulysses, when Achilles fought Ulysses in the presence of the now unconscious 'Savage Banner' (the result of a psychological failsafe created by the currently intelligent Hulk where he would turn back into Banner if he became enraged).

achmed korba.first_appearance: Peter Parker, The Spectacular Spider-Man Vol 1 4
achmed korba.origin: Achmed Korba had a restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City, which he used as a front for smuggling and espionage. One day, while on a country expedition, he encountered the Man-Beast, who granted him power in exchange for loyalty. In order to maintain him under control, Man-Beast limited Achmed's powers so that they could only be used when in contact with an innocent and pure being. Achmed chose Sha Shan as his wife, and she was forced by her father to accept in order to maintain the balance of the universe. Together, they became Brother Power and Sister Sun and led a cult called the Legion of Light. thumb|left|150px|Achmed Korba Achmed then traveled to the US with Sha Shan and, in a short time, opened a restaurant in New York. From there, he promoted the Legion of Light as a peace-loving organization and began amounting followers, but its true purpose was to gather people who could then be manipulated as pawns of the Man-Beast. The Man-Beast was eventually defeated by Spider Man and Flash Thompson, and Sha Shan was freed from the mission imposed by her father, as Achmed died in an explosion.
powers: When in contact with Sister Sun, Achmed could fire powerful burst of energy from his chest.

acrobat 1940s.name: Acrobat (1940s)
acrobat 1940s.origin: thumb|left|98px|unmaskedThe man known as the Acrobat was an acrobat at a local New York fair during the 1940s. Acrobat learned that the fair was having a City of the Future model building competition that offered a grand prize of ten thousand dollars. The Acrobat built a model he called the City of the 1960s and put it on display. Fearing competition, the Acrobat sought to sabotage the model constructed by the students of the Lee School presented by Betsy Ross, leading to clash with Captain America and Bucky who were guests of the fair. The Acrobat fled from Captain America and got away at his own acrobatics show through a trap door in the water tank he dove into. The Acrobat's second attempt at sabotage led to yet another chase, in which the Acrobat managed to lose the heroes in the nearby House of Mirrors. When the awards were about to be announced, the Acrobat stole a race car and kidnapped the judge and the prize money, however this time Captain America and Bucky were able to stop him. The Acrobat was unmasked and turned over to the authorities and the prize money was awarded to the Lee School.
abilities: The , as his name suggests, was skilled in acrobatics.

adalbert kamentin.name: Adalbert Kamentin
adalbert kamentin.origin: Kamentin was a mad botanist who in the fall of 1942 had an entire garden full of man-eating plants. Obsessed with feeding his creations human beings, he and his minion Kixor would go out into the town below his castle and get fresh victims every night there was a full moon. His activities attracted the attention of the Vision who traveled to the region to put an end to Kamentin's murderous creations. The Vision allowed himself to be captured by Kamentin and Kixor to be brought to the killers' castle. There, the Vision and a captured female broke free from their bonds and confronted Kamentin. Kamentin unleashed his plants on the two, but when they broke free, the frightened botanist attempted to flee the scene. As he ran away from the Vision, Kamentin tripped and ended up falling into the maw of one of his own plants and was eaten alive.
abilities: Kamentin was a brilliant botanist.

adam aziz.name: Adam Aziz
adam aziz.origin: thumb|left|150px|Adam's appearance with the power of Thor Adam Aziz was a mechanic that lived in Broxton, Oklahoma almost his entire life. Adam once spent nine years in federal prison for aggravated assault and armed robbery. Adam ran an auto shop and fixed cars for people who couldn't afford to have their cars fixed. One day, the magic hammer Mjolnir landed near his shop. When Adam went to investigate, he discovered Tony Stark's phone number engraved on the hammer. So, Adam called Tony about the hammer, and Tony arrived soon after. While Tony talked to a crowd of onlookers, Adam told Tony that the inscription on Mjolnir had changed to pick it up. Out of safety concerns, Tony set up a force field around Mjolnir. However, Adam was within the force field. Ignoring warnings from Tony to not touch Mjolnir, Adam touched it and was transformed into a being similar to Thor. Thor appeared later to collect Mjolnir from Adam, but was interrupted by Tony. Then it was revealed the magic of Odin on it was broken so that, like Adam, anyone could wield it despite their worthiness. After a brief conversation with Iron Man, Adam made a wish to Thor to fly in the sky like a bird, like he always saw them fly. Thor granted it and then Adam returned to normal by slamming Mjolnir hard on the ground. Before going, he advised Thor that most things can be repaired by turning them off and on, and if that didn't work, then hammer it until it's fixed.

adam bentley.name: Adam Bentley
adam bentley.origin: Adam Bentley was a comic-book character created by artist and writer Larry Lieber who somehow gained awareness beyond his fictional existence. Through unknown circumstances, Bentley escaped the boundaries of his comic narrative and manifested within the real world, effectively breaking the fourth wall. Once in reality, Bentley became increasingly distressed, claiming he was being pursued by unseen figures he referred to only as “Them.” Witnesses observed him running through city streets in panic, shouting warnings about invisible pursuers that no one else could perceive, leading authorities and bystanders to believe he was mentally unstable. Seeking protection, Bentley voluntarily approached a police station and begged officers to confine him in a jail cell, convinced that imprisonment would prevent his pursuers from reaching him. The police complied, intending to have him examined by a physician rather than formally arrest him. However, when the doctor and an officer later returned to the cell, Bentley had vanished without explanation. It was later implied that Bentley’s disappearance coincided with the rejection of the comic story in which he appeared. With the narrative abandoned, Bentley was drawn back into the fictional realm alongside the other characters from the unpublished tale.

adam berman.name: Adam Berman
adam berman.origin: Adam Berman was a brilliant student at Newton North High School. Adam applied for a position at Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters without informing the headmasters that he was, in fact, a mutant himself, afraid he would receive the treatment other public mutants received. Adam admired the great scientists and hoped that given the right opportunity he might make a name for himself. However, the headmasters, Banshee and Emma Frost chose Adam's longtime academic rival Ginny Mahoney instead. Simultaneously, Adam had also been noticed by Bastion, leader of Operation Zero Tolerance, an organization dedicated to the eradication of mutant kind. Bastion converted Ginny into a Prime Sentinel, and charged her with the mission to infiltrate Xavier's School and publicly destroy Adam. Ginny witnessed Adam using his power on local bully Jocko Wilkins to frighten him away, and began to make romantic overtures towards Adam in order to obtain a saliva sample from his mouth, so naturally she kissed him. Determined to convince Banshee to let him into Xavier's School, Adam met with him at the school, but Emma Frost used her telepathic powers to activate Adam's own abilities. Adam scrapped with Banshee before realizing that he was a mutant as well, then fled. The next day, Banshee gave a lecture at Adam's school, just as Ginny made her assault upon Adam. Using the sample she had obtained earlier, Ginny activated Adam's powers, causing him to run amok. Ginny then stepped into the fray in Prime Sentinel mode, claiming to be protecting bystanders from the mutant menace. Banshee and Adam fought Ginny, and in the midst of the battle, Adam observed that the only person injuring bystanders was Ginny herself, the true antagonist. Faced with this fact, Ginny returned to normal, kissed Adam one last time, then fled the scene. Banshee brought Adam to Xavier's School and offered him a place there, at last, but by then, Adam had decided that he shouldn't segregate himself from society. As Adam drove away from the school with his friends M'Bala and Arlo, Arlo described his powers as totally primal. Adam liked the sound of that.

adam blackveil.name: Adam Blackveil
adam blackveil.species: First man created by Ex Nihilo
adam blackveil.origin: "Adam" was the first humanoid being created by Ex Nihilo in his effort to create life anew on Earth. But as soon as he emerged from his cocoon, his ability to speak in Builder Machine Code made Nihilo and his sister Abyss think something was wrong. He was later taken into custody of the Avengers in order to study him and try to decode his language. Tony Stark managed to decode his name into "Blackveil." After a therapy session with the new Captain Universe, Shang-Chi was told the presence of it was because the universe was dying. Captain Universe and "Blackveil" met, and as she managed to translate his language correctly, she discovered his name was Nightmask and he was announcing that the White Event was coming to Earth. In that moment, a blaze of lightning from outer space hit the Earth. ===Starbrand=== Nightmask led the Avengers in finding the Starbrand host, Kevin Connor, who was located at the ruins of a college, and aided them in destroying his empowerment. After a brief battle with the Avengers, Kevin Connor was taken by Nightmask to Mars, in order to seek help from Ex Nihilo. In the meantime, he explained to Starbrand what caused his powers and what his purpose was. left|thumb|Nightmask and Starbrand confront Ex Nihilo Nightmask teleported Connor and himself to Croatia, one of the places modified by Ex Nihilo, where strange creatures started forming a brain-like structure. The "brain" tried to absorb Nightmask, but he was rescued by Starbrand, who accidentally killed the organism in the process, "killing" the Earth's potential consciousness. The Avengers arrived on the scene and attempted to stop them. They fought back until Starbrand surrendered. As they were out of options, the heroes decided it would be better for Starbrand to be off the Earth and placed him in Tony Stark's which was under construction around the Sun, in the company of Nightmask. When Captain Universe sensed a new threat coming to Earth, her own children, the Builders, she advised the Avengers to recruit Nightmask and Starbrand into the team, which they did. ===Time Runs Out=== After the Avengers fell into S.H.I.E.L.D. authority, Starbrand and Nightmask left the team to investigate the decay of the universe. For some reason, Nightmask began to rejuvenate. They returned to Earth when they received a message from Sunspot, inviting them to join his own Avengers team as there had been new progress on the research related to Incursions. Using A.I.M.'s resources, Sunspot managed to put into operation a machine capable of transporting individuals across the Multiverse, in hopes of finding the source of the decay of the Multiverse, and a group of them, the "Multiversal Avengers," embarked in said mission. Nightmask was among these heroes. thumb|right|200px|Rejuvenated Nightmask In their journey, the Multiversal Avengers arrived to the base of the Black Priests, whom they believed to be enemies, as they would destroy alternate Earths. After discovering their true motivation, that of saving the Multiverse, the Multiversal Avengers allied with the Black Priests, and were informed of the true enemies they had to face, the Ivory Kings and Rabum Alal. While the Black Priests tried to find Rabum Alal, the Multiversal Avengers would set out to find the Ivory Kings (also known as the Beyonders). The Avengers traveled across numerous universes, navigating the map left by the Mapmakers. The use of his powers caused Nightmask to rejuvenate, and the final jump across universes caused him to revert into non-existence. ===All New All Different=== When the universe came back to life, so did Nightmask and the rest of its inhabitants, with no memory of their temporary demise. After defeating Blizzard in China, he was offered membership by Sunspot in his New Avengers, but he declined and, instead, he started attending Empire State University along with Kevin Connor. On the first day of college, they were attacked by mind-controlled Nitro, Graviton, and Blizzard twice, and the second time almost cost Kevin's life, because he was fighting the three of them on his own. Meanwhile, Adam was tracking the source of their control and found out the responsible were the Eternity's children Explosion, Gravitation, and Entropy. After taking away their control over the Earth criminals, he returned to Earth and both he and Kevin attended their first college party. 180px|thumb|left|Fighting the mind-controled villains The next day, Kevin and Adam met with Kolobus, after Libra brought them together. Then, Kolobus helped them prevent the Kree Starbrand from killing Kevin and destroying Earth, although, in the end, it was revealed that there was a fail-safe in the Starbrand power that caused them to become attracted to one another and kiss. Because of this, they called off the fight and Va-Sohn agreed not to attack any more worlds, as Kevin would be there to "make things cosmically awkward". ===Secret Empire=== Sometime later, as trillions of Chitauri were approaching the E

adam casim.name: Adam Casim
adam casim.origin: While vacation to Boston, Massachusetts, Adam Casim and his family were attacked by Shiv, who killed Adam's wife and son. Adam attacked Shiv setting the car ablaze with a flare, as well as himself. Still on fire, Adam kept attacking Shiv, but after the Nightstalkers incapacitated Shiv, Adam collapsed. However, the occult energies from Shiv had had their effect on Adam. Adam was taken to a Massachusetts General hospital, where he was visited by a sympathetic Punisher while Adam laid in a nearly comatose state. Frank told him that he knew what Adam was going through and that while he would never get back what he had lost, he would live with himself by making the thing that wronged you pay. Unbeknownst to Frank, Adam heard his words and was inspired to retaliate against what had wronged him: the occult. Escaping from the hospital, Adam attacked and killed a group of orderlies for their mystical (superstition) beliefs, leaving behind only the man who had scoffed at their fears. Adam then confronted Verna Mae, a psychic reader, and incinerated her as well. Continuing his mission, Adam eventually made contact with Shiv, who had come to Magickal Brew in search of a black market baby for his rituals. Both Shiv and Adam were tracked by the Nightstalkers and the Punisher, who found them at Magickal Brew. Adam confronted Shiv, who had lost his powers as a result of an energy blast from Frank Drake's gun Linda. Adam attacked the helpless Shiv but was told to stand down by Frank because Shiv was a killer, and that made him the Punisher's to kill. Meanwhile, the Nightstalkers had vowed to destroy anything supernatural and threatened to slay Adam. Adam slew Shiv and then Frank Drake, Frank Castle, and Linda fired at Adam, killing him.

adam clayton.origin: thumb|150px|left|Clayton runs to fast to be seen by the human eye.Adam Clayton was a scientist that used his self created Vibra Light device to bombard himself with vibrating light molecules and speed up the molecules of his own body. This granted Adam the ability to run at speeds so high that Adam is undetectable to the human eye, thus granting Adam the title of Invisible Man. adam cross.origin: Adam Cross, along with several other first responders, aided in the recovery after the Chitaruri invaded New York where they kept a souvenir alien helmet. Months after, Adam, Frank Whalen and Tony Diaz decided to polish the helmet. The helmet carried an alien virus, which Adam contracted. While out as a scout leader, Adam began to feel the effects of the virus, and was eventually killed by it. The virus caused the body of the victim to float in mid air after death, While Jemma Simmons was investigating the body of Cross, a spark jumped from Adam's dead body to Jemma, transmitting the virus to her.

adam gree.origin: Adam Gree was a business tycoon whose scientists predicted an end to disease, war, and poverty in the year 2001. To reach this point, he closed all his businesses and liquidated all of his assets to build a machine that would transport him forty years into the future. adam harkins.name: Adam Harkins
adam harkins.origin: Adam Harkins was the head of the Facility, the organization responsible for creating X-23. Adam had dealings with the Purifiers and ordered the kidnapping of Mercury so that he could use her skin to create Predator X, a deadly mutant hunting monster specially designed to find and kill the Mutant Messiah. When the New X-Men and the X-Men raided the Facility to save Mercury, Adam managed to escape. Later Adam again worked with the Purifiers, creating a Choir of angelic warriors by copying the wings of Archangel. Even though Archangel killed every member of the Choir, Adam again escaped unharmed. Some time later, however, Adam's agent Kimura, under the mental control of Emma Frost, tried to kill him. Adam somehow escaped with a limp and managed to free Kimura from the mind control. When the Facility managed to capture X-23, Adam ordered Kimura to take a DNA sample from her so that the Facility could create more clones of X-23. When X-23 escaped and went berserk through the Facility, Adam feared for his life and called for Kimura to protect him. Kimura managed to temporarily subdue X-23, but when Adam wanted X-23 alive Kimura betrayed him and shot him in the head.

adam henderson.origin: Adam Henderson was an english teacher from Cherry Hill Illinois. After getting upset one evening about being stuck as a teacher for so long and not getting into music, he stormed out on his wife Maureen and was possessed by Null the Living Darkness. Under Null's command he traveled around town, killing along the way till he found the Quentin Carnival where he revealed his origins to Madam Olga. He grabbed Pastor Oliver Matheson who he called a fraud and kidnapped him. Adam returned home where he was confronted by Ghost Rider. A short fight ensues and when Adam/Null attempted to crush him with a statue, Maureen was nearly crushed instead. This allowed Adam's personality to resurface and gave Ghost Rider the opportunity to expel Null. Adam then reconciled with his wife.

adam mann.name: Adam Mann
adam mann.origin: Adam Mann was raised by a single mother and never knew his father. As a boy, Adam's head was filled with myths and legends of ancient gods through bedtime stories his mother read to him. As a man, Adam excelled in sports and went on to win more Olympic gold medals than any other athlete in history. Adam's accomplishments were so great he was tested for the X gene, but Adam was not a mutant. Gaining several endorsements, Adam made a financial fortune, and then built a business empire. Adam always suspected his father was an errant god like Hercules and began collecting ancient artifacts to harness their mystical energy, intending to amass so much energy that he could travel to places like Asgard or Olympus to find his father and slay him for abandonment. When Adam detected a new energy source to collect Adam and his private strike force attacked Thunderstrike and his Asgardian protector Gruenhilda. Adam nearly killed Kevin but before he could siphon the power from Kevin's mace, Mangog arrived, unintentionally summoned to Earth by the Mysticator. When Mangog asked if they were gods, Adam acknowledged this claim with pride, so Mangog devoured him.

adam roderick.name: Adam Roderick
adam roderick.species: Human with Inhuman lineageCategory:Human/Inhuman Hybrids activated by a Terrigen Bomb but rendered inert by Magister Karnak
adam roderick.origin: Adam Roderick was a Nuhuman whose powers were activated by the Terrigen Mist cloud. Adam was allegedly kidnapped by the I.D.I.C., a splinter group from A.I.M, who claimed responsibility with a video delivered directly to S.H.I.E.L.D. via a proxy server. Due to complications regarding the legal status of Inhumans, S.H.I.E.L.D. hired Magister Karnak to recover the boy, and Karnak promptly and violently interrogated a mole within S.H.I.E.L.D.'s own ranks to learn I.D.I.C. were holed up in a safehouse in Berlin, Germany. When Karnak eventually located Adam, he appeared before Karnak while accompanied by I.D.I.C. priests at their headquarters, the Chapel of the Single Shadow, in Transia. There, Adam revealed to Karnak that he was never abducted by the terrorist cell, rather they convinced him to go along to discover his true self, including finding out that whatever he said and/or thought would become reality, such as the massive single eye within the premises of the complex. Adam wished Karnak to tell his family that he loved them and missed them but had no intention of coming home for the foreseeable future, due to their never really encouraging him to be more than what he was. When the Magister tried to apprehend him by force, one of his altered bodyguards stood in to defend him. Adam took note of how Karnak's abilities worked, realizing they lacked effectiveness if he could not adequately see his targets and so made himself and his followers invisible. Roderick then bade him a final farewell, before warping away to parts unknown, greatly irking the agitated hermit. Karnak eventually found Adam again and fought off I.D.I.C. members who Adam transformed into spider-like creatures. Adam tried to placate Karnak by trying to bestow upon him something he wanted, but Karnak stopped him by damaging the part of Adam's brain that controlled his powers. Karnak then delivered a second blow that gave Adam brain damage. Adam was returned to his parents with Karnak's predicting that he would eventually recover from the brain damage.

adam rykland.name: Adam Rykland
adam rykland.origin: Adam Rykland was one of the many employees of Stark International present during the Tomorrow Academy's field trip to Stark Industries. He was later involved in stealing Vibranium from Wakanda that was currently being sold by N'Kya. When Pepper Potts noticed the Black Panther watching Rykland from above, she decided to follow him upon recognizing him from the field trip. Pepper and the Black Panther located Rykland in an underground facility, though Pepper had accidentally activated the alarm system, thus provoking Rykland to send out the unsuccessful Delta team to deal with the intruders. Once Rykland met up with N'Kya, he was disappointed upon seeing the Black Knight. Believing the exchange was a scam until he was reassured by N'Kya herself, who decided to raise the price of the Vibranuanim due to recent events. When Iron Man and the Black Panther arrived, Rykland and his men attempted to defeat the Black Panther, though they were subdued by him and were all defeated. Rykland, as well as other individuals involved with the illegal trade, were arrested by S.H.I.E.L.D and sent to The Vault.

adam spectre.name: Adam Spectre
adam spectre.origin: In the late 37th early 39th century, Adam Spectre was a member of the Clan Chosen, an Askani inspired team of freedom fighters, formed originally by Nathan Dayspring, Tetherblood, and Aliya. In the late 36th century, Apocalypse ascended to power and ruled much of North America unchallenged, for 100 years, where humans and whoever else resistant to his rule could be killed at any moment. The Clan Askani were the only rebellion left to opposed Apocalypse's rule. Years later, following the destruction of the Askani Sisterhood by the New Canaanites led by Ch'vayre and Stryfe, and the fall of Apocalypse by Nathan Dayspring, Adam joined the Clan Chosen. Training in the Askani ways under surviving Askani elders, the Clan Chosen repeatedly battled the New Canaanites and the Scions of Apocalypse, led by Stryfe. The Clan Chosen also clashed with the Neo Canaanites, a group that also wished to claim Apocalypse's power. ===Death=== After decades of battle, the Clan Chosen signed a long-lasting peace treaty with the New Canaanites, but Nathan, upset by rumors that Apocalypse had survived, convinced the Clan's Askani Council that they needed to fight again. However, ensuing battles cost the Clan dearly and the following war nearly destroyed all life on Earth. Among the dead was Adam.

adele santiago.name: Adele Santiago
adele santiago.origin: Adele Santiago worked as a nurse and physical therapist for drug kingpin Victor Hierra. For approximately two years she treated his chronic medical problems, which included diabetes, palsy, and brittle bones, while avoiding involvement in his criminal activities. During one visit to Hierra’s residence, Adele was inside a locked office with him when her brother phoned her. While she was speaking with him, Hierra suddenly collapsed and died. Unknown to those present, the assassin called Coyote had remotely drained the blood from Hierra’s body, leaving no visible evidence of the attack. Hierra’s bodyguards immediately suspected Adele of murder and had her arrested. She was initially assigned the corrupt attorney Robert Ranney as her defense counsel, but her brother sought outside help and eventually secured legal representation from Foggy Nelson instead. fields.history: Adele Santiago worked as a nurse and physical therapist for drug kingpin Victor Hierra. For approximately two years she treated his chronic medical problems, which included diabetes, palsy, and brittle bones, while avoiding involvement in his criminal activities. During one visit to Hierra’s residence, Adele was inside a locked office with him when her brother phoned her. While she was speaking with him, Hierra suddenly collapsed and died. Unknown to those present, the assassin called Coyote had remotely drained the blood from Hierra’s body, leaving no visible evidence of the attack. Hierra’s bodyguards immediately suspected Adele of murder and had her arrested. She was initially assigned the corrupt attorney Robert Ranney as her defense counsel, but her brother sought outside help and eventually secured legal representation from Foggy Nelson instead. The murders committed by Coyote were later exposed, and he was found guilty of the killings, leading to Adele being cleared of the charges against her.

adena.name: Adena
adena.origin: Adena was first seen chasing the Beast sent by Dormammu through New York alongside Baron Mordo, Wong, and her fellow sorcerers. They pursue and kill it where the Sanctum Sanctorum is cloaked by magic. Although victorious, Adena, Wong, and the others were momentarily seen through their disguise by Stephen Strange. Adena was then seen returning to Kamar-Taj though the Nexus veil. Then Adena was seen walking through the halls as she and the others returned to New York to fend off a wave of Shadow Hounds. During the fight, Adena manages to save fellow sorcerer Miro. She and her team suffered a few casualties, including Lucy. Upon returning to Kamar-Taj, she was seen tending to Miro on her way in. The next time they returned to New York, they face the Chinou. During the battle, Adena was knocked off its back by the tail. After Wong took over Stephen's training, Adena and the other sorcerers trained him in staff wielding. After Stephen completed his training, she followed the other disciples to New York to face the last of Dormammu's threats, the Wing Marks. During the fight, the Ancient One had Adena and Miro guard the Sanctum's entrance with their lives. Adena was left fighting the Wing Marks after her last two allies were devoured. As Adena struggled to hold her own against the swarm, the Ancient One stepped in, ordering her to retreat to safety. Adena refused to leave behind her master as one last act of loyalty. The two held up a powerful barrier spell to protect themselves from the flesh-eating swarm. Unfortunately, Adena buckled under the strain and let out a scream as the Wing Marks consumed her in seconds. Although perished, Adena's sacrifice allows the Ancient One to use all his strength and vaporize the entire swarm in an explosion, but it soon cost him his own life.

administrator.name: Administrator
administrator.origin: The Administrador first made himself known by hiring Deadpool to track down and kidnap Wolverine. He routinely bled and drugged Wolverine while he studied his mutant healing factor. It wasn't until Logan was liberated by Geronimo Crowe that he learned of the Administrator's sinister plans. The cyborg ran an anti-mutant faction known as the Watchtower who sought to study and eradicate mutants. Hellbent on destroying the mutant-hating cyborg, Wolverine swore to track him down. Much later, Wolverine tracked the elusive cyborg to another facility holding Caliban. A fight ensued with the hostage mutant but it was quickly stopped by the arrival of X-Force. However the cyborg made his presence known, sporting a new armor. He was able to easily take down Cable, Wolverine, and even Deadpool before he was shot and killed from behind by an alternate Stryfe.
powers: His armor can absorb mutants' powers to fuel itself, , , , and .
weaknesses: Dependent on the armor for life.

admiral footsu.name: Admiral Footsu
admiral footsu.origin: Admiral Footsu was part of the Imperial Japanese Navy during World War II. In 1944, he was stationed in Kobe, Japan, where he had workers constructing a massive super-sub to use against American ships that would encroach on the waters near Japan. When the Sub-Mariner attempted to destroy the sub, his soldiers trapped the hero in a net and gassed him. After dehydrating the hero with sun lamps, Footsu ordered the Sub-Mariner to be put in a water tight room while he launched an attack against an American battleship fleet. However, the Sub-Mariner escaped and after Footsu's attack forced the American ships to pull back, Namor forced his way aboard the super-sub. Battling the soldiers, Namor grabbed Footsu and used him as a human shield to reach the ballast controls. There Namor set off a bomb that caused the super-sub to rapidly fill with water. Namor then fled leaving Footsu and his men to drown aboard the sinking submarine.

By the summer of 1942 his subordinate Captain Nitsu had constructed false submarine periscopes in order to trick American ships into wasting ammunition on false targets. admiral nodope.name: Admiral Nodope
admiral nodope.origin: Admiral Nodope was part of Imperial Japan's navy during World War II. Following the attack on Pearl Harbor on December 7th, 1941, the Japanese sent a fleet of troops to attack the San Francisco coast. Admiral Nodope led ships on this attack. They were opposed by the Human Torch and his sidekick Toro. The two flaming heroes damaged Nodope's ship, forcing him to retreat back to Japan. There, he was ordered by his superiors to prevent the Torch and Toro from fleeing the country with a bunch of recently liberated American soldiers. During the conflict, the Torch and Toro turned a pile of scrap metal into a tidal wave of molten metal which they used to smother the Japanese soldiers attacking them. The soldiers were killed instantly, including Admiral Nodope.

adrian corbo.name: Adrian Corbo
adrian corbo.first_appearance: Alpha Flight: In the Beginning Vol 1 -1
adrian corbo.origin: Adrian is one of the two Corbo brothers. They are maternal half-brothers, from the same mother but different fathers. Adrian and his older half-brother Jared were raised in the Hull House orphanage, which was actually a facility operated by the Canadian government's secretive agency Department H. There they met Eugene Judd, who was working at the orphanage. Adrian once had a peculiar flashback to his childhood in Hull House. In the flashback a very young Adrian was holding his teddy bear and calling to Beatrice de la Salle for help. There was a monster with red eyes towering over him. The monster threatened to eat his eyes. Adrian connected this memory with the feeling of being cornered and unable to get away from someone he trusts. While Adrian was shy, reserved, and bookish, Jared was athletically inclined, aggressive, and arrogant. Both brothers manifested mutant powers after puberty: Adrian gained the ability to transform parts of his body into blades, while Jared manifested a personal force field that could not be deactivated. According to Jared, the codename "Flex" derives from a childhood nickname for Adrian, used by everyone even before he received his powers. Adrian was the scrawniest kid at the orphanage. One day, during their physical training, Jared decided to tease his brother about it. He asked Adrian to "flex" his muscles and show them off to their class. That night, during dinner, another boy called Adrian "Flex" and the nickname stuck. When the "Frankenstein doctors" of Hull House eventually found out that Adrian's power actually was activated by flexing, they turned the nickname into a codename. The brothers were recruited into an incarnation of the Canadian superhero team Alpha Flight as Flex and Radius. They assisted Alpha Flight in battling several foes, including the Zodiac, the Brass Bishop, and Department H's own power-mad leader, Jeremy Clarke, who died of radiation poisoning during a Zodiac raid on the Department H headquarters. Their Alpha Flight team fought several members of the original Flight and later teamed up with them to defeat a new Weapon X, created by a rogue Department H scientist. Both groups of Alphans merged into a unified Alpha Flight following this adventure. The Corbo brothers and several other members of the new team were later reassigned to Alpha Flight's trainee team, Beta Flight. After the events of M-Day, Corbo lost his mutant abilities. His current whereabouts are unknown.

When the "Frankenstein doctors" of Hull House eventually found out that Adrian's power actually was activated by flexing, they turned the nickname into a codename. The brothers were recruited into an incarnation of the Canadian superhero team Alpha Flight as Flex and Radius. They assisted Alpha Flight in battling several foes, including the Zodiac, the Brass Bishop, and Department H's own power-mad leader, Jeremy Clarke, who died of radiation poisoning during a Zodiac raid on the Department H headquarters. Their Alpha Flight team fought several members of the original Flight and later teamed up with them to defeat a new Weapon X, created by a rogue Department H scientist. Both groups of Alphans merged into a unified Alpha Flight following this adventure. The Corbo brothers and several other members of the new team were later reassigned to Alpha Flight's trainee team, Beta Flight. After the events of M-Day, Corbo lost his mutant abilities. His current whereabouts are unknown.

fields.notes: The identity of the monster in Adrian Corbo's flashback is unclear, though it is implied that the monster was someone who the child trusted. The form of the monster was not humanoid, though it could speak. While Adrian Corbo's monster has very few lines of dialogue, they still form a distinctive pattern: "Help you she can't, young thing! Sure of that I am. Mmmm pretty eyes you have. Eat them I could". This seems to be an inverted syntax, where lines do not follow traditional sentence patterns. The narration of (February, 1998) provides some information on the religious beliefs of Flex. He reportedly believes in heaven. He also believes there are souls inside every living being, souls that call out to each other across the great void of life. The S.H.I.E.L.D. database of mutants known to have lost their mutant abilities during M-Day included Murmur and Radius, but did not include Flex.
fields.trivia: His astrological symbol is Pisces, so he was born sometime between February 8 and March 20.

adrian eiskalt.name: Adrian Eiskalt
adrian eiskalt.origin: During the cold war, Adrian Eiskalt was a soldier in the East German Army. Along with his brother, Utë, he took part in a failed attack on Wundagore Mountain, and was forced to flee when his unit was attacked by Magneto who destroyed their vehicles and weapons. While retreating, the Eiskalt brothers stumbled across the grave of Magda Eisenhardt, Magneto's wife. When Magneto demanded they leave, Adrian's brother drew his gun. Magneto shielded himself, and Ute's bullet ricocheted back at him, killing him. Adrian survived and became obsessed with avenging his brother, convincing himself that Magneto had deliberately killed Ute. Years later, he joined a small task force dedicated to capturing Magneto – Adrian, however, intended to use the technology he'd been given to avenge his brother and kill the master of magnetism. Armed with a metal-free weapon and a bodysuit that would mask his bio-electric readings from Magneto's senses, Adrian lay in wait near Magda's grave, certain that Magneto would return to his wife's grave. There he saw Magneto crying over his dead wife, and for once, he recognized his enemy as a person and not just a monster. Remembering the truth about his brother's death, he abandoned his mission of revenge, realizing hate had consumed his life.
weapons: A taser gun dubbed the "Slingshot" (metal-free). He also carries a poisoned needle.

adrian lynn.name: Adrian Lynn
adrian lynn.origin: Adrian Lynn was crippled in a deadly car accident. She tried to recover the use of her legs via an experimental adrenal gland transplant. The treatment worked, but she lusted for more power and continued the treatment until she gained superhuman strength. Seeking revenge against She-Hulk for putting her husband in prison, Adrenazon disguised herself as She-Hulk and implicated her in crimes. After the serum caused her to have a mental breakdown, she began to believe she was the Sensational She-Hulk. After having a flashback, the serum overwhelmed her and she passed out. She blocked the Sensational She-Hulk from being stunned by guards from the Tombs. Later, after the serum had worn off, she accepted her husband's guilt and the Sensational She-Hulk accompanied her to his grave.

adrienne brashear.name: Adrienne Brashear
adrienne brashear.origin: Dr. Adrienne Brashear was the daughter of Adam Brashear, also known as the super hero Blue Marvel. Adrienne was the soon-to-be-promoted assistant administrator of Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S.. As part of their research on renewable energy sources, Adrienne was investigating Iso-8, hoping to use the theorized similarities with Cosmic Cubes for the benefit of humanity. Adrienne received Captain Marvel when she visited the Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S. Facility investigating the lecture of Cosmic Cube energy signatures. As soon as she learned that Adrienne was working with both Iso-8 and Cosmic Cube fragments, Carol shut the project down. However, Brashear's student Logan Lewis was confident they were close to a breakthrough and subjected herself to the Iso-8 compound they were working on. She was quite scared at first, as she began losing control over her body, but Adrienne Brashear helped her get stabilized and later developed a special suit that would help her manage her new powers.

Adrienne's husband and son had a falling out, leading James Jr. to abandon his father's identity in favor of a new look as Captain Hawk. After James Sr. passed away during the Overmind War, Adrienne helped James Jr. reconcile his feelings for his father with a new, but still reminiscent identity as Blue Eagle. Later she was abducted by members of the Institute of Evil and held hostage. She and the other hostages were eventually freed by the Squadron Supreme. Adrienne Dore was killed along with the other natives of Earth when this reality was destroyed.

adur.name: Adur
adur.origin: Adur was an already powerful leader among his people, but he began using human sacrifices in attempts to gain dark power and ultimately became immortal, and gained the ability to manipulate fire. He formed the Deathwalkers along with Cairn, Lichidus and Viciada, people with similar origins to his, and worked together to gain more power. left|thumb|150px|Adur in a flashback from Since old times, they tried to use the Talisman of Kamar-Taj to create a sacrifice so powerful it would destroy humanity. A failed attempt in 1908 caused the creation of The Bear. In 1972, one of their attempts to make the sacrifice was thwarted by the Mighty Avengers. The Talisman was taken from them and it was hidden in the Himalayas by Kaluu. The Talisman made its way to the Inhumans' Attilan. In the present times, the Deathwalkers returned to New York, and rediscovered the Talisman once Attilan fell on New York. Lichidus sent a hellhound to retrieve it, but if failed and Blade (who was undercover as Ronin) took it. The Deathwalkers then proceeded to send numerous creatures to fight the vampire slayer and get it. They finally succedeed in capturing Blade after sending Were-Roosters to battle him, and planned to use his blood for a sacrifice. Even though the Mighty Avengers located Blade and arrived to help him, the Deathwalker's legion of servants provided a distraction so the heroes couldn't get to Deathwalkers before they could finish their ritual. The successfully-finished ceremony merged them together into the Deathwalker Prime, a creature with control over the four elements, thus power over the fifth: the spirit, which would be the key for it to destroy humankind. However, the Mighty Avengers managed to get hold of the cup used in the ritual of merging, and using a similar procedure merged themselves into the Avenger Prime, which managed to destroy the Deathwalker Prime, mainly because unlike the Deathwalker, the different personas merged into it were truly spiritually bonded, while the personas composing the Deathwalker were fighting for control.
powers: Adur can control fire.

aegis monster.name: Aegis (Monster)
aegis monster.origin: Aegis was one of the six original creations of the young monster fanatic Inhuman Kei Kawade, who possessed the ability to summon whichever monsters he drew on his notebook. However, the drawings of these six monsters sit unfinished. When Kei used his powers to help fend off the invading Leviathon Tide, Moon Girl flipped through his notebook and suggested to finish the drawings of Aegis and the others. Kei shot her down, believing that his powers would only work on existing creatures. When the Leviathon Mother made earthfall to finish her children's job and kill Kei, she defeated all of the monsters that Kei had summoned. The young Inhuman decided to try his hand at summoning the original monsters as a last-ditch attempt to stop her. The plan worked, and Kei was able to summon Aegis alongside his other five creations: Slizzik, Hi-Vo, Fireclaw, Scragg, and Mekara. The group of monsters was on the verge of winning until the Leviathon Mother impaled and killed Fireclaw. This turn of events prompted Kei to try out another untested gambit. He used his powers to merge the remaining monsters and himself into Smasher, who managed to kill the Leviathon Mother, causing most of the remaining Leviathons to flee the Earth. fields.history: Aegis was one of the six original creations of the young monster fanatic Inhuman Kei Kawade, who possessed the ability to summon whichever monsters he drew on his notebook. However, the drawings of these six monsters sit unfinished. When Kei used his powers to help fend off the invading Leviathon Tide, Moon Girl flipped through his notebook and suggested to finish the drawings of Aegis and the others. Kei shot her down, believing that his powers would only work on existing creatures. When the Leviathon Mother made earthfall to finish her children's job and kill Kei, she defeated all of the monsters that Kei had summoned. The young Inhuman decided to try his hand at summoning the original monsters as a last-ditch attempt to stop her. The plan worked, and Kei was able to summon Aegis alongside his other five creations: Slizzik, Hi-Vo, Fireclaw, Scragg, and Mekara. The group of monsters was on the verge of winning until the Leviathon Mother impaled and killed Fireclaw. This turn of events prompted Kei to try out another untested gambit. aegisthus.name: Aegisthus
aegisthus.origin: ===Early years=== Aegisthus murdered Atreus, king of Mycenae, and supplanted him as king. Atreus' sons Agamemnon and Menelaus fled to Sparta. Later, Agamemnon, married to Spartan princess Clytemnestra, returned to Mycenae, defeated Aegisthus, and became king. ===Trojan War=== As Agamemnon sailed to war on Troy, after sacrificing their daughter Iphigenia at Aulis, to retrieve his brother's wife Helen, stolen by Prince Paris, Aegisthus became the lover of Clytemnestra. When Agamemnon returned to Mycenae after the war, and despite having been warned by Achilles's ghost, he was caught in nets by Aegisthus and Clytemnestra, who slaughtered him. Cassandra, king of Troy Priam's daughter, that Agamemnon had taken for himself as the end of the war was killed as well in the process.

aelfric.name: Aelfric
aelfric.origin: Aelfric was originally a monk serving in the Abbey of St. Michael in 12th century Spain. Under undescribed circumstances he came under the sway of Chthon whom the monk believed to be Satan, and started worshiping him. Chthon directed him to reassemble the lost scrolls of the Darkhold which had been scattered across the world by St. Brendan about six centuries before. By 1149, Aelfric succeeded in reassembling the Darkhold, but his work was discovered by his fellow monks and they believed him to be an agent of Satan. Fleeing with his scrolls, he was soon opposed by a mounted knight who struck him with his sword. Aelfric could not be killed through such means, however, and reduced both the knight and his steed to nothing more than a pile of bones through the use of the Grey Death. He was quickly swarmed by the townspeople after this, as the knight was the patron to the king for the town. They then burned both him and his scrolls at the stake, though the Mad Monk vowed that his soul would live on and he would return to rule the world. Later, petty scavengers found the scrolls among Aelfric's remains, completely unharmed by the fire. These scrolls passed hands through the ages until they came into the possession of Gregory Russoff who bound the pages into the current copy of the Darkhold. As a result of reading the pages, Russoff became a werewolf, a curse he passed on to his children Jack and Lissa. Jack took the book to Father Ramón Jóquez to have it translated from Latin, which inadvertently released the spirit of Aelfric into the world once more. Aelfric succeeded in possessing the priest and planned to send the world back to the dark ages with Grey Death. Aelfric captured the Werewolf by binding him to the wall with his magic and also captured Lissa who was looking for her brother and fainted when she ran into Aelfric. The Werewolf soon escaped his shackles and confronted Aelfric, who then summoned Dragonus to deal with the Werewolf, hoping to unleash his evil side in the process. Unfortunately for Aelfric, during the fight Dragonus tripped over the Werewolf and impaled the body of Father Jóquez with his horns, causing his spirit to leave the dying body.

aelsa featherwine of the fay.name: Aelsa Featherwine of the Fay
aelsa featherwine of the fay.origin: Aelsa Featherwine of the Fay was the queen of the Light Elves of Alfheim and has reigned for at least dozens of years. At some point and for some reason (possibly simply for the sake of the challenge), Thor Odinson crept upon her in her sleep in order to steal a lock of her hair. Unfortunately for him, she woke up and set him on fire, and it took him two decades to regrow his beard properly. Years later, the Warriors Three wanted to judge the new female Thor, and asked her to prove herself capable of many feats Thor Odinson had accomplished. Among those, the stealing of a lock of Aelsa's hair. Thor accomplished that feat by simply waking up the Elf Queen and addressing her demand. When Malekith the Accursed and his Dark Elves invaded Alfheim as part of the War of the Realms, Aelsa tried to negotiate with him. During the private meeting for negotiations, she was brainwashed with magic by the Enchantress and forced to take Malekith's hand in marriage to unify the Light and the Dark Elves. Following the marriage, Aelsa snapped out of the brainwashing and was imprisoned in her own dungeons. The Dark Elves proceeded to raze Afheim and consume its resources over the following months. The League of Realms tried to rescue Alesa, but they were instead lured to a trap. While the League fended off Dark Elves, Malekith set in motion his plan to burn down Alfheim after having determined the realm outlived its usefulness. After starting a fire, Malekith attempted to murder Queen Aelsa. While she was plummeting to her death, Aelsa was saved by Mjolnir and taken to safety. Thor subsequently cast a storm to extinguish the flames, but most of Ljosalfgard had already burned down. During the Dark Council's assault on Midgard, Earth's heroes mounted a counter-offensive to fend off the invaders. When the Asgardian All-Mother Freya took control of the Malekith's Black Bifrost, she used it to send Midgard's heroes to recruit allies from across the realms. The Light Elves, including Queen Aelsa, were recruited by the Punisher, forming the Light Elf Rifle Brigade, which was deployed in Africa to fight off the Angels of Heven, helping in the efforts that ultimately would result in Malekith's death and the end of the War of the Realms.
powers: She possibly had powers, having set Thor Odinson on fire.

aera.name: Aera
aera.origin: Aera is an Aerwan sorceress from the Wold, one of the many lands of the Godwheel. Some time ago, she stole a powerful and corrupting talisman known as the Vorlexx, bringing it to Earth where it was hidden, never to be used again. Aera began living in London at the Darke Shoppe, a magical establishment catering to the supernatural. There she met Lela Cho, and conducted a reading forecasting their alliance as part of a group known as the Solution. Along with Troy Wilde and the Darkurian Vurk, the quartet became a mercenary team. Aera assumed the Ultra codename of Shadowmage.

aerika harkness.name: Aerika Harkness
aerika harkness.origin: Granddaughter of Agatha Harkness, the sorceress who trained Scarlet Witch, the young Aerika was a powerful witch herself. She was invited to join the Dream Team, a group of heroes who were going to become part of the new Avengers, A-Next. She donned a costume and an alias in honor of her "sister", the Scarlet Witch, and became the Crimson Curse. As the Crimson Curse, Aerika used her magic to affect the elements of nature, and strove to maintain harmony between herself and order of nature. This led to her having a very level-headed and reserved attitude. Her powers made her an invaluable ally against the many foes that they encountered. Her biggest challenge was when she was sent to aid the original Avengers in a dark parallel reality. The Red Skull's heir Doom was going to use his Cosmic Cube to send his Thunder Guard into her reality. Crimson Curse couldn't allow this and used her powers over nature to counteract the supernatural energies of the cube. She succeeded, but the price was her life. Her sacrifice was a shock to her teammates. But in the end, her death was avenged by the Avengers, who defeated Doom and his minions. At some point, Aerika resurrected and joined American Dream's Dream Team. Together they attacked Spider-Woman, believing her to be an impostor who had killed Spider-Man.

aerivar xviii.name: Aerivar XVIII
aerivar xviii.origin: Aerivar the 18th was King of the Bird People. In the 1920's, when the child who would become Red Raven was found, Aerivar adopted him, despite some subjects' fear that he would cause their end, and had him became the heir of Cheiros, a bat-winged Inhuman deemed traitor and killed during the secession, for the human to atone to their bloody past. In 1940, at Red Raven's twentieth birthday, Red Raven was given artificial bat-like wings and sent by Aerivar to help humanity. He became convinced that ordinary humans were inferior to the Bird People and ordered an attack on humanity shortly after World War II. The attack was prevented by Red Raven who placed all the Bird People in suspended animation and had their island sink into the Atlantic Ocean.

aeroika.name: Aeroika
aeroika.origin: Aeroika was one of the many Winged Ones created by Ytitnedion and forced to serve the Buzzard People in Ogeon. The other Winged Ones managed to smuggle Aeroika out. He wanted to locate the Defenders and join their fight against the Unnameable, supposedly to fulfill an old prophecy of his race. Aeroika stayed at an inn for several days, expecting the Defenders to eventually arrive there. Shortly after their return to the Tunnelworld, the Defenders met him at the inn. Aeroika led the Defenders to a safe place, under the protection of the Nya. The Defenders narrated tales of their past to him, while Aeroika explained the prophecy to his new allies. In the sacred valley of the Nya, the Defenders were attacked by an advance force of Ytitnedion's army. Aeroika suffered an arrow wound in the shoulder, but the Hulk forced the attackers to retreat. Dr. Strange treated Aeroika's injury with local medicinal herbs, promising a speedy recovery to his patient. Shortly later, Aeroika served as the team's guide on its way to Ogeon. Aeroika convinced two merchants to help the Defenders sneak their way into Ogeon. The Defenders expected to meet Xhoohx in Ogeon's interior, but they were dismayed when they learned that he had already been captured by enemy forces. Aeroika attemted to convince two local soldiers to let him pass without questioning what or who he was transporting, claiming that he was following the orders of Ytitnedion's nephew. Namor impatiently attacked the soldiers instead. The sounds of the battle caused nearby Winged Ones to break away from their slave caravans and to rise in revolt. Following the initial battle, Aeroika rallied the other Winged Ones to take up arms and to continue fighting for their Freedon. Dr. Strange and Namor pessimistically noted that the Winged Ones lacked the weapons and supplies needed to succeed. Several Winged Ones were killed by one of Ytitnedion's Crushers, but Aeroika led the others to regroup and to counter-attack. Later, he personally led a small group in a successful attempt to sneak into Ytitnedion's castle through the sewers. They located several tortured prisoners, but they decided to offer a swift mercy kill to the ones too far gone to ever recover. The Unnameable had managed to mind-control the Hulk, who had been captured in an earlier battle. The Hulk was send to attack Aeroika's rebels, but Dr. Strange managed to temporarily neutralise the Hulk. Aeroika was able to protect Strange from Ytitnedion's direct attacks. Aeroika eventually knocked out Ytitnedion, by hitting him on the head with the flat of his sword. Aeroika announced to the people of Ogeon that Ytitnedion had been overthrown, though most of them were more concerned about a potential attack by the Unnameable. Aeroika led the Defenders to the edge of the Tunnelword, where they intended to bury their slain ally Xhoohx. Ytitnedion used the distraction to free himself and the mind-controlled Hulk from captivity. The duo attacked the Defenders, and the Unnameable soon arrived to help them. The Unnameable created manifestations of the Hulk's foes (based on the Hulk's memories) and used them against the Defenders. Dr. Strange eventually managed to defeat the Unnameable, which was left trapped within the Hulk's mind. Aeroika returned home as a free person, though he mused about eventually traveling beyond the confines of Tunnelworld.
abilities: Talented swordsman and combatant.

aerolite.origin: thumb|left Aerolite was a member of Stella Nega's team of Guardians of the Galaxy operating around 1016 A.D. Born and raised to be a warrior, she was a formidable but reluctant fighter and preferred to solve problems by means other than violence. She used a Universal Translator which was not properly calibrated, giving her a distinct and unusual speech pattern. Her team fought the invading forces of Newcomers who had invaded Iraq on Earth and were turning their victims into hybrid warriors. They teamed up with the Guardians of the Galaxy from the 21st century and the Guardians of the Galaxy from the 31st century to battle the invaders.

aftaab lemar.name: Aftaab Lemar
aftaab lemar.origin: Aftaab Lemar was an Afghani terrorist and one of several men responsible for the murder of scientist Ho Yinsen. Fifteen years after Yinsen's death, Lemar was serving in Southern Iraq under the command of another of Yinsen's murderers, General Zakim Karzai. The son of Ho Yinsen, wishing to avenge his father's death, took control of Tony Stark as well as his bio-enhanced Extremis Armor and flew to Iraq. Iron Man grabbed both Lemar and Karzai, flew them high into the sky, then let them fall to their deaths.

afterburner.name: Afterburner
afterburner.first_appearance: Silver Sable and the Wild Pack Vol 1 21
afterburner.origin: Afterburner was a young woman with super-speed powers who worked, along with other supervillains, for the crimelord Justin Hammer. Hammer, intending to buy the land in Beverly Hills, cheaply, had turned to Latisha Arnold to organize 130 street gangs into a murdering army to scare away the estate owners and the authorities - yet the landowners had hired Silver Sable's elite mercenary team Wild Pack to recover their property. Arnold contacted Hammer to tell him that the Wild Pack was defeating the gangs, and Hammer sent a team of armored supervillains to reinforce his side - these included Afterburner, the Beetle, Blacklash, Blizzard, Boomerang, Cyclone and the Spymaster. The villains broke into the police precinct that Arnold was using as a base and which the Wild Pack was storming. Afterburner ran to confront the Wild Pack's Douglas Powell, hitting him repeatedly, but she found that he had extraordinary endurance. Soon after, Blacklash unleashed his whip on Powell, which kept him busy and gave Afterburner the chance to escape and find another enemy. After the Intruders arrived to reinforce the Pack, Afterburner joined Boomerang, Cyclone and Spymaster against Intruders' Lightbright, who initially believed that Afterburner's associates were ogling at her. However, soon after, the street gangs turned against Hammer's agents; Afterburner collaborated with Cyclone to keep the gang members at bay, expressing her displeasure, but Cyclone did not respond; she noted that Cyclone had never told her anything. After Arnold's brother was killed by Blizzard, the supervillains decided to retreat and Blizzard joined the others, escaping from there in a hover-transport.
powers: She had , reflexes, and agility, but normal strength.

aftermath sleeper.name: Aftermath (Sleeper)
aftermath sleeper.origin: Aftermath was the third Sleeper created by Doorman, whose job was to defend England in the event the Gulf War turned nuclear and was designed to absorb energy. He was stored in an unused aviary until awakened by Oonagh Mullarkey. Plasmer, Captain America, Captain Britain and Silver Surfer (Norrin Radd) tried to stop it from awakening but it absorbed the Power Cosmic from the Surfer and used it to become more powerful. Since he was attacked, Aftermath believed that England had been conquered by its enemies, and activated his "Earth-Burn" scenario which wouldn't leave anything in London standing. However, he quickly grew beyond his programming and set about a new plan, to conquer. He swatted away the heroes when they tried to stop him and when Oonagh attempted to gain control, he set about trying to destroy her instead. The Doorman revealed he was the creator of the Sleepers, and assisted in defeating Aftermath by containing Plasmer into an ultra dense state, effectively making her a mini big bang, and the Silver Surfer launched her at Aftermath, destroying him.

agamemnon mythology.name: Agamemnon (Mythology)
agamemnon mythology.first_appearance: Marvel Classics Comics Series Featuring Vol 1 18: The Odyssey
agamemnon mythology.origin: ===Origin and early years=== Agamemnon was the son of Atreus, king of Mycenae, and of Queen Aërope, granddaughter of King Minos of Crete. He had a brother, Menelaus. When his father was murdered and his kingship usurped by Aegisthus, the brothers fled to Sparta. There, Agamemnon married the Spartan princess Clytemnestra. He returned to Mycenae, defeated Aegisthus, and became king. At some point, he became the High King of the Argives. ===Trojan War=== When Menelaus' wife Helen was abducted by Prince Paris of Troy, Agamemnon gathered the Achaeans, and led them in the siege of Troy. He was killed by his wife and her lover Aegisthus. ===Modern Days=== During World War II, the spirit of Menelaus endowed the "the battle-prowess of Agamemnon" to American teenager Lon Crag.

agent mojoverse.name: Agent (Mojoverse)
agent mojoverse.species: Spiral transformed in the Body Shoppe her past self Ricochet Rita into Mojo's Agent.
agent mojoverse.origin: The Agent was a denizen of Mojoverse, a parallel universe centering around a culture of mass television viewing, ruled by the literally spineless creature known as Mojo. The first Agent was created by Mojo's sorceress, Spiral. Spiral twisted the form of her own past self, the stuntwoman-turned-adventurer Ricochet Rita, into the Agent. Mojo hired the Agent to capture the X-Babies after they had escaped to Earth-616. The X-Babies were rescued by the mutant Shadowcat and her team, Excalibur. Her teammate, Rachel Summers, freed Rita from the form of the Agent. Though the X-Babies were free, Rita remained bound to Mojo's contract. The X-Babies agreed to return to the Mojoverse in exchange for Rita's freedom. Rita elected to accompany the X-Babies back to the Mojoverse as their guardian. The Agent was rebuilt by Mojo and given his own persona. The Agent was sent to sign the hero Wonder Man to a contract, and he succeeded. However, Mojo was enraged at Wonder Man's screen test performance of Shakespeare, and Wonder Man was fired.

agent anesthesia.name: Agent Anesthesia
agent anesthesia.origin: Anesthesia is a Sleepwalker/human hybrid raised in the Mindscape where lies and deception do not exist. Her human father sleeps in a comatose state, and Monica Rappaccini, Supreme Scientist of A.I.M., promised to help him in exchange for Anesthesia's assistance. Trusting Rappaccini's word, she infiltrated the Infinite Avengers Mansion through the sleeping mind of Ant-Man (Eric O'Grady) and stole a device called Heaven, created by Wasp (Henry Pym) that housed Goliath (Bill Foster)'s consciousness. When Wasp and Ant-Man followed her back to A.I.M.'s base, Anesthesia realized she was being used since Rappaccini was more concerned with their capture than her father's welfare. Bargaining to free Ant-Man from Rappaccini's trap in exchange for taking her father to safety, Ana was duped again and zapped unconscious by Ant-Man once he was free. Soon after she attempted to escape with her father from A.I.M.'s flying headquarters while the Avengers battled A.I.M.'s forces, but she lacked the strength to lift him. Ant-Man offered to help, but Anesthesia refused to trust him and remained on board the ship as Wasp teleported it to an alternate future where barbarism ruled, science was dead, and A.I.M. was responsible for it. Anesthesia somehow returned from this alternate future, moving herself and her no-longer-comatose father into Shatterstar's apartment building for displaced natives of alternate realities Manor Crossing.

Her human father sleeps in a comatose state, and Monica Rappaccini, Supreme Scientist of A.I.M., promised to help him in exchange for Anesthesia's assistance. When Wasp and Ant-Man followed her back to A.I.M.'s base, Anesthesia realized she was being used since Rappaccini was more concerned with their capture than her father's welfare. Bargaining to free Ant-Man from Rappaccini's trap in exchange for taking her father to safety, Ana was duped again and zapped unconscious by Ant-Man once he was free. agent baines.name: Agent Baines
agent baines.origin: When S.H.I.E.L.D. created the special Operation: Lightning Storm team led by Ms. Marvel, Agent Baines was assigned as technical expert. Having observed that Ms. Marvel had logged in aboard the Minicarrier, he went to meet her calling her but she chased him shouting that he was taking a shower. During a mission to capture Julia Carpenter, Carol ordered Agent Baines to stay on the Minicarrier and to alert local law enforcement if there were any problems. Shortly after the differences between Julia and Carol were smoothed out, Baines identified where Julia's parents and her daughter Rachel had moved. In the mission to flush out the A.I.M., Baines using his portable technological equipment discovered that A.I.M. had been able to access the Calabi-Yau Spheres, then explaining what the Spheres were and what the A.I.M. he had been able to punch holes in the spheres and slide an object inside. After meeting with Monica Rappaccini, Baines understood that the A.I.M. he had inserted the spheres was a G-TAC Scrambler, so Ms. Marvel asked if he was able to follow the bites of the spheres and he replied that it was the easiest thing to do and in fact he was able to locate them easily and with them track down the A.I.M. After returning to the Minicarrier, Carol told Baines, that was watching the prisoned Monica Rappaccini, that he could return to the bridge and he jokingly replied that if they needed him they would find him illegally downloading Hydra videos. Ms. Marvel asked Baines if he was able to replicate the A.I.M. Teleportation Protocols so that they could immediately reach New York where M.O.D.O.K. raged through its streets and Baines did. But immediately afterwards Rappaccini accused Baines of being in league with a traitor agent of the A.I.M. then she freed herself and killed him.
abilities: Agent Baines was an expert at the limit of genius in the field of computers and electronic technologies.

agent baxter.name: Agent Baxter
agent baxter.origin: Agent Baxter was an operative working against Home Base who tracked the organization's activities while operating under a variety of disguises. During one mission, he infiltrated a small town disguised as an elderly woman and entered an adult bookstore that had been used as a dead drop by Home Base. After provoking a disturbance, he drew the attention of local police, then produced a concealed firearm hidden inside his cane and killed the responding officers, the store owner, and another customer before searching the premises. Removing his disguise, Baxter located the concealed compartment used by Home Base but discovered that the data disc containing footage of one of the organization's operatives undergoing plastic surgery had already been removed. Continuing his investigation, he visited a local bar under the cover identity of a lingerie salesman. After the bartender invited him to her room under the pretense of purchasing merchandise, Baxter anticipated the trap laid for him. When the woman attempted to draw a hidden pistol, he was quicker, fatally shooting her with a weapon concealed in the bed. He then searched the room and recovered the missing disc, which had been hidden inside the woman's brassiere. Continuing his investigation into Home Base, Agent Baxter examined the recovered surgical recording in greater detail. Although the procedure initially revealed only the gruesome removal of a woman's face, the operation concluded with the application of a new identity that left remarkably little visible scarring. When the patient's bandages were finally removed, Baxter was stunned to recognize the woman's true identity, confirming that Home Base had successfully concealed one of its operatives through extensive reconstructive surgery. Baxter subsequently contacted his employers and demanded a higher payment in exchange for the disc, realizing the information it contained was far more valuable than originally believed. When his organization attempted to silence him by sending an assassin, Baxter survived the attack thanks to a concealed Kevlar vest, quickly overpowered the would-be killer, and warned his employers that unless they met his price, he would return the disc to Home Base. Before leaving, he staged the scene to make it appear that his attacker had committed suicide. Baxter also revealed that the recording exposed not only the identity of Home Base's undercover operative, but also the individual's alternate identity as the mysterious Mr. Blue. Agent Baxter met with Agent Kelly to exchange the disc carrying the identity of Mr. Blue.
